echoTasks.find: Right atrial plus right ventricular diastolic collapse around a circumferential effusion
Dilated inferior vena cava with minimal collapse on sniff
Low LVOT VTI on pulsed Doppler with exaggerated respiratory variation of inflow

exam.general: Breathless man propped upright, tachypnoeic, cool hands
exam.jvp: Raised 8 cm with a sharp x descent
exam.other: Tender liver edge, lungs clear, no focal neurology

history.a: Viral fever two weeks ago, then progressive breathlessness and chest heaviness for 5 days
Can no longer lie flat, sleeps in a chair
No tuberculosis contact, no malignancy, no renal disease
No chest pain now, dull ache earlier eased by sitting forward
On no regular drugs, no alcohol
Small trader, sole earner, family anxious about a procedure

keyPoints: Follow the tamponade protocol order: subxiphoid effusion check, chamber collapse, caval imaging, then inflow variation
Arrange urgent pericardiocentesis with the full image set saved for the proceduralist
Avoid diuretics and keep preload up with monitored fluids while awaiting drainage
Send fluid for aetiology and plan cause directed treatment after the tap
Log gain, depth and sector settings so the post drainage study is directly comparable
management.model: Protocol order imaging with urgent drainage, preload preservation, and comparable post procedure documentation

accept: right atrial plus right ventricular collapse
required.answer: right atrial plus right ventricular collapse

sources: ESC guideline on pericardial disease, in own words
Point of care ultrasound protocol guidance for pericardial tamponade, in own words
stem: A 52 year old trader from Nashik, two weeks after a viral fever, presents with 5 days of progressive breathlessness and inability to lie flat. Tachycardia with a quiet precordium, raised JVP and pulsus paradoxus are found.
teaching: Established means both chambers collapsing with tachycardia and a dilated cava
The sonographer runs the protocol order every time: effusion, collapse, cava, inflow
A saved comparable image set is what the proceduralist needs for safe drainage
Preload preservation between diagnosis and drainage keeps output up
title: Established cardiac tamponade in protocol order
